name: dlc2_48g
description: DLC 2 start with Lara as doppelganger_casual: test 48g (own fade shader libs 2494-2526, translated from the title update; doppelganger_casual + player_tru_dlc2_extension), DLC 2 player / doppelganger / rock vein / shadow power 0.5.1 plugins, TruLink + TruMenu 0.5. Checks the look, the D3D error box and the wall run; three switches for bisecting.

tests.text: TruDlc2Player Costume (lara_doppelganger -> doppelganger_casual at level load)
Wait in the main menu until it is shown completely
Press L3 + R3: TruMenu opens, TO TEST is the first page
TO TEST: the three switches above are as wanted (a change needs a restart of the game)
Load the DLC 2 start (A = Run + done). Known bug: the first Run can land in dlc_caverns - then Run once more
Wait until the level has loaded and Lara can be moved, close the menu (L3 + R3)
Lara looks like the doppelganger (doppelganger_casual, no grey / wrong textures)
No D3D error box (D3DERR_INVALIDCALL 0x8876086C) and no crash after the load
Go to the first rock channel (Felsrinne) and hold RB, then A at the wall
Wall run: Lara runs along the wall, no crash, no box
Mark the checks (A ok, X fail, Y skip), then end the game normally
